background: AIB Group is the holding company of Allied Irish Banks, one of Ireland's two dominant retail and business banks, funded by Irish deposits and lending mainly on Irish mortgages and to Irish companies.
synthesis: Only one of the three main agencies rates the group, at BBB+ on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade on 6 Nov 2025, so the rating is thinner than the balance sheet suggests. Capital is strong, with CET1 of 16.4% and leverage of 6.7% both above the peer median for EU and Nordic banks. Liquidity is stronger still, with LCR of 198% and NSFR of 158% both in the top quarter. Since 30 Jun 2025 leverage has fallen 0.4 points and NSFR 7 points, small moves from a high base.
